Good performance: 0.44s per max-size instance including startup (~0.2s startup). All infeasible though — let me make them feasible to test the optimal path at max size too. Let me set demands small and capacities large, and a big budget.

Also let me check memory usage for the largest LPs.

Let me create a feasible variant of the long-path stress test.

arguments.command:
cd /app/work && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import json, sys, subprocess, time, resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work')
import longpath, check as C
# feasible variant: small demands, large capacities, huge budget
reqs=[]
for i in range(8):
    r = longpath.gen(100+i)
    for e in r['edges']: e['capacity'] = 1024
    for c in r['commodities']: c['demand'] = 1 if c['demand'] else 0
    r['budget'] = 98304
    r['failed_edges'] = []
    reqs.append(r)
data="".join(json.dumps(r)+"\n" for r in reqs).encode()
t0=time.time(); p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/app/submission/planner.py'],input=data,capture_output=True,timeout=900); dt=time.time()-t0
print("planner %.2fs"%dt, "stderr:",p.stderr.decode()[:300])
lines=p.stdout.decode().splitlines()
from collections import Counter
c=Counter(); bad=0; mx=0
for i,r in enumerate(reqs):
    L=C.build(r); resp=json.loads(lines[i])
    try:
        st,val=C.check_response(r,resp,L); c[st]+=1
        if st=="optimal": mx=max(mx,abs(val))
    except Exception as e:
        bad+=1; print("FAIL",i,repr(e))
print(c,"bad",bad,"max mlu",mx)
# peak RSS of planner on the single biggest instance
big=max(range(8), key=lambda i: sum(len(x) for cm in reqs[i]['commodities'] for x in cm['paths']))
t0=time.time()
q=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-c','''
import resource, subprocess, sys, json
data=open("/dev/stdin","rb").read()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/app/submission/planner.py"],input=data,capture_output=True)
u=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print("peak child RSS MiB", u.ru_maxrss/1024.0, file=sys.stderr)
'''], input=json.dumps(reqs[big]).encode()+b"\n", capture_output=True)
print("single %.2fs"%(time.time()-t0), q.stderr.decode()[:200])
PYEOF
